mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals economic weakness that triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months with UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production above 105.0, supply chain improvements boost corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP growth signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI exceeds 3.0%, it indicates persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months with CPIAUCSL > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1300 thousand units, it indicates strong housing market activity that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate sectoral momentum.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST > 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with UNRATE < 3.5%.
